title: quiet-fold — one short line low on an almost empty band
idea: Most of the band is empty. One sentence at reading scale sits low against a hairline, with two facts beneath it. No image, no display type, no button — the confidence is in what is left out.
why_new: type-manifesto is the loud imageless recipe — a display headline filling the band. This is its opposite, and the catalog has no quiet register at all.
built_from: a constrained group, one heading at body-adjacent scale, one hairline, one meta row. The simplest recipe to ship.
risk: reads as unfinished if the vertical rhythm is wrong; the empty space must be a fixed proportion of the band, not whatever the copy leaves over.
